I wrote the page to `./solution.tsx`. I couldn't run it, so it's untested.

It follows your spec:
- **Trigger:** a secondary "Delete project" button opens the modal.
- **Dialog text:** the title is "Delete this project?" and the description is "Its files and history are removed. This cannot be undone."
- **Actions:** "Keep project" is a secondary button that closes the dialog. "Delete" is the primary button. It closes the dialog and sets the status text "Project deleted.", which sits next to the trigger in a `role="status"` element so screen readers announce it.

It uses the kit's `Dialog` parts, so focus trapping, Escape to close and returning focus to the trigger come from the kit. Colours and spacing come from brand token variables, so it should follow all three brands.
